template.name: UPS Net AgentA by SNMP
template.description:
Zabbix template for NetAgentA smart module for UPS.
By Aleksey Kuznetsov, ljflats@gmail.com
Version 2.0

item.name: upsBaseBatteryStatus
item.description: The status of the UPS batteries. A batteryLow(3) value indicates the UPS will be unable to sustain the current load, and its services will be lost if power is not restored. The amount of run time in reserve at the time of low battery can be configured by the upsSmartConfigLowBatteryRunTime.

item.name: upsBaseBatteryTimeOnBattery
item.description: The elapsed time in seconds since the UPS has switched to battery power.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryCapacity
item.description: The remaining battery capacity expressed in percent of full capacity.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryCurrent
item.description: The current battery current expressed in percent of maximum current.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryFullChargeVoltage
item.description: The fully charged battery voltage of the battery system used in the UPS, expressed in tenths of a volt.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryReplaceIndicator
item.description: Indicates whether the UPS batteries need replacing.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryRunTimeRemaining
item.description: The UPS battery run time remaining before battery exhaustion, in seconds.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryTemperature
item.description: The current internal UPS temperature expressed in tenths of a Celsius degree.

item.name: upsSmartBatteryVoltage
item.description: The current battery voltage expressed in 1/10 VDC.

item.name: upsBaseInputPhase
item.description: The current AC input phase.

item.name: upsSmartInputFrequency
item.description: The current input frequency to the UPS system in 1/10 Hz.

item.name: upsSmartInputLineFailCause
item.description: The reason for the occurrence of the last transfer to UPS battery power. The variable is set to noTransfer(1) if there is no transfer yet. The variable is set to highLineVoltage(2) if the transfer to battery is caused by an over voltage greater than the high transfer voltage. The variable is set to brownout(3) if the duration of the outage is greater than five seconds and the line voltage is between 40 percent of the rated output voltage and the low transfer voltage. The variable is set to blackout(4) if the duration of the outage is greater than five seconds and the line voltage is between 40 percent of the rated output voltage and ground. The variable is set to smallMomentarySag(5) if the duration of the outage is less than five seconds and the line voltage is between 40 percent of the rated output voltage and the low transfer voltage. The variable is set to deepMomentarySag(6) if the duration of the outage is less than five seconds and the line voltage is between 40 percent of the rated output voltage and ground.

item.description: The current utility line voltage in 1/10 VAC.

item.name: upsSmartInputMaxLineVoltage
item.description: The maximum utility line voltage in 1/10 VAC over the previous 1 minute period.

item.name: upsSmartInputMinLineVoltage

item.name: upsBaseOutputPhase
item.description: The current output phase.

item.name: upsBaseOutputStatus
item.description: The current state of the UPS. If the UPS is unable to determine the state of the UPS this variable is set to unknown(1).

item.name: upsSmartOutputFrequency
item.description: The current output frequency of the UPS system in 1/10 Hz.

item.name: upsSmartOutputLoad
item.description: The current UPS load expressed in percent of rated capacity.

item.name: upsSmartOutputVoltage
item.description: The output voltage of the UPS system in 1/10 VAC.

item.name: SNMP traps
item.description: Перехватывает сообщения от роутеров Cisco ASR9006

item.name: System contact details
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB The textual identification of the contact person for this managed node, together with information on how to contact this person. If no contact information is known, the value is the zero-length string.

item.name: System description
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB A textual description of the entity. This value should include the full name and version identification of the system's hardware type, software operating-system, and networking software.

item.name: Uptime (hardware)
item.description: MIB: HOST-RESOURCES-MIB The amount of time since this host was last initialized. Note that this is different from sysUpTime in the SNMPv2-MIB [RFC1907] because sysUpTime is the uptime of the network management portion of the system.

item.name: System location
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB The physical location of this node (e.g., `telephone closet, 3rd floor'). If the location is unknown, the value is the zero-length string.

item.name: System name
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB An administratively-assigned name for this managed node.By convention, this is the node's fully-qualified domain name. If the name is unknown, the value is the zero-length string.

trigger.expression: last(/UPS Net AgentA by SNMP/system.name[sysName.0],#1)<>last(/UPS Net AgentA by SNMP/system.name[sysName.0],#2) and length(last(/UPS Net AgentA by SNMP/system.name[sysName.0]))>0
trigger.name: System name has changed
trigger.description: System name has changed. Ack to close.

item.name: Uptime (network)
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB The time (in hundredths of a second) since the network management portion of the system was last re-initialized.

item.name: System object ID
item.description: MIB: SNMPv2-MIB The vendor's authoritative identification of the network management subsystem contained in the entity. This value is allocated within the SMI enterprises subtree (1.3.6.1.4.1) and provides an easy and unambiguous means for determining`what kind of box' is being managed. For example, if vendor`Flintstones, Inc.' was assigned the subtree1.3.6.1.4.1.4242, it could assign the identifier 1.3.6.1.4.1.4242.1.1 to its `Fred Router'.

item.name: SNMP agent availability
item.description: Availability of SNMP checks on the host. The value of this item corresponds to availability icons in the host list. Possible value: 0 - not available 1 - available 2 - unknown

trigger.name: No SNMP data collection
trigger.description: SNMP is not available for polling. Please check device connectivity and SNMP settings.
